data: Does WER decrease with increasing beam width for WER Oracle?

To determine if WER decreases with increasing beam width for WER Oracle, I will analyze the red line in the graph, which represents WER Oracle. The x-axis represents Beam Width, and the y-axis represents WER. The red line starts at approximately 12 on the y-axis when the beam width is 12 and decreases as the beam width increases. By the time the beam width reaches 32, the red line has decreased to approximately 4 on the y-axis. Therefore, WER Oracle decreases with increasing beam width.
